statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = len(arr) and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), r[i] = 1 + N_i, where N_i is the number of distinct integers v such that v occurs in arr (that is, there exists j with 0 <= j < len(arr) and arr[j] = v) and v < arr[i]. In words, r[i] is one plus the number of distinct values in arr that are strictly smaller than arr[i].
preconditions: 0 <= len(arr) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), -1000000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000000.
